jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Order to Cash Platform (SAP BRIM)
jobs.description:
Principal Product Manager Order to Cash Platform (SAP BRIM)

Location:
San Jose, CA

Our Company

Adobe is changing the world through digital experiences. We empower everyone - from emerging artists to global brands - to create and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We are passionate about building innovative products that transform how businesses engage with their customers.

The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and modernization of our Order-to-Cash (O2C) platform powered by SAP BRIM. This highly visible role is responsible for defining the future of Adobe's monetization platform, supporting both B2B and B2C business models across subscriptions, usage-based offerings, digital commerce, and enterprise licensing.

As a Principal Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for critical Order to Cash (OTC) capabilities. You will partner closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, and Tax teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities that support Adobe's evolving business needs.

The ideal candidate combines deep O2C domain expertise with strong Product Management fundamentals and SAP BRIM experience. You have successfully owned enterprise platform strategy, prioritized roadmap investments, driven measurable business outcomes, and influenced senior stakeholders in complex cross-functional environments.

Who You Are

You are a product leader who thinks beyond system implementation and focuses on solving business problems through scalable platform capabilities.

You have experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for enterprise platforms and understand how monetization, billing, revenue management, and financial processes work together to support business growth.

You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on technical tradeoffs, collaborating with business stakeholders on priorities, and influencing executive leaders through data-driven recommendations and clear product strategy.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Roadmap

Define and own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Adobe's O2C platform.
Identify opportunities to improve scalability, operational efficiency, compliance, and customer experience across the monetization ecosystem.
Prioritize platform investments based on business value, customer impact, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
Influence executive stakeholders and partner with business leaders to align roadmap priorities with Adobe's strategic objectives.
Establish success metrics, KPIs, and outcome-based measures to evaluate product investments and platform performance.

Product Management & Execution

Own product requirements, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and delivery for key OTC capabilities.
Translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, epics, user stories, and product decisions.
Drive product discovery, solution evaluation, and business case development for strategic initiatives.
Make prioritization decisions by balancing business value, customer needs, technical complexity, and operational impact.
Partner closely with engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to ensure successful execution and delivery.

OTC Transformation

Lead product strategy and cross-functional execution for strategic OTC transformation initiatives.
Drive modernization efforts that support Adobe's evolving monetization models and operational requirements.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering teams to define future-state platform capabilities and scalable solution approaches.
Support ERP modernization initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP RISE transformations, ensuring alignment with Adobe's OTC strategy.
Ensure solutions support subscriptions, recurring revenue, usage-based billing, digital commerce, and enterprise licensing business models.

SAP BRIM Product Ownership

Provide product leadership across SAP BRIM capabilities including:

Subscription Order Management (SOM)
Convergent Charging (CC)
Convergent Invoicing (CI)
Financial Contract Accounting (FICA)
Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)
SAP S/4HANA integrations

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, Tax, Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture teams to define and deliver business capabilities.
Influence and align stakeholders across multiple organizations and leadership levels.
Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
Build consensus across competing priorities while maintaining focus on long-term platform objectives and business outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
12+ years of experience in Product Management, Enterprise Platforms, Business Systems, OTC, Billing, Revenue Management, or related domains.
5+ years of Product Management experience with ownership of product strategy, roadmap, and delivery.
Experience owning the strategy and roadmap for enterprise, OTC, billing, revenue management, or monetization platforms.
Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and business outcomes for enterprise business platforms.
Proven track record of making product investment decisions and prioritization tradeoffs across multiple stakeholder groups.
Experience serving as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or Platform Product Leader - not solely as a SAP BRIM functional lead, implementation consultant, solution architect, systems analyst, or program manager.
At least one end-to-end SAP BRIM implementation supporting both B2B and B2C business models.
Experience participating in or leading SAP ERP modernization programs, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP RISE transformations, with a strong understanding of impacts to O2C, Revenue Management, Finance, and SAP BRIM ecosystems.
Deep understanding of subscription commerce, recurring revenue, usage-based billing, invoicing, collections, revenue management, and monetization processes.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and drive organizational alignment.

Preferred Qualifications

Deep expertise across SAP BRIM modules including SOM, CC, CI, FICA, and RAR.
Strong understanding of SAP SD and SAP Finance/FICO.
Experience working within SaaS, Software, Digital Media, or Technology companies.
Experience defining future-state platform capabilities and partnering with architecture teams on modernization initiatives.
Proven ability to identify business problems, define product vision, evaluate tradeoffs, and make strategic platform recommendations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs, operational metrics, and business outcomes for enterprise platforms.
Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
Experience operating within Agile product development environments and collaborating closely with engineering teams.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will:

Establish and execute a multi-year roadmap for Adobe's SAP BRIM-powered OTC platform.
Deliver strategic platform enhancements that improve scalability, reliability, operational efficiency, and business agility.
Drive successful modernization initiatives supporting Adobe's monetization and ERP transformation objectives.
Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, and Tax organizations.
Deliver measurable improvements across billing, invoicing, revenue management, and monetization capabilities.
Help influence the future direction of Adobe's O2C platform and monetization ecosystem.

Why Adobe

At Adobe, you'll work on some of the most complex monetization and business platform challenges in the industry. You'll have the opportunity to shape platform strategy, drive transformative initiatives, and help build the systems that power Adobe's global business.

This role offers the chance to influence critical business capabilities, partner with leaders across the company, and deliver solutions that support millions of customers worldwide.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager with deep fluency in the AI ecosystem to lead the evolution of our engineering platform. The rapid adoption of AI is fundamentally reshaping how we build, ship, and scale software at Adobe. To keep pace, we are developing our platform into a builder and efficiency platform. It will support thousands of agents and hundreds of developers, PMs, and multi-functional contributors. This leader will own our agentic development platform end-to-end including setting the vision, aligning teams, and driving measurable outcomes for our teams.

What You'll Do

You will hold primary product responsibility for our agentic developer platform, with accountability across two core areas.

Agentic Platform Layer

As part of making our engineering teams and partners more productive, we're building an agentic layer for our engineering platform - a single, shared source for agentic workflows, MCP servers, session management, evals, and observability.

Identify use cases across engineering teams that can be streamlined with agents and translate those findings into a clear platform roadmap.
Align team members and executives on the platform's critical outcomes and represent them as measurable goals and outcomes that keep the team focused.

Define and deliver an agentic-first, autonomous development solution that works effectively for engineers today.
Develop a long-term vision for translating ideas from any contributor into impactful product features.
Ensure a scalable, reliable technical foundation built for a world where agent-generated code is the norm.
Iterate on the agentic vision through concrete, measurable improvements to developer efficiency.

Demonstrated proficiency with, and genuine enthusiasm for, AI. You track the technology closely and translate it into practical, strategic product decisions.

Set the engineering operating model for productionizing custom generative models across image, video, and 3D — including the architectural patterns that simplify pipeline construction and let us absorb a heterogeneous mix of internal and external models without linear engineering cost.
Own the unit economics of Firefly Foundry inference. Cost-to-serve, GPU utilization, and gross margin on the managed service are your numbers.
Define the tenancy and data-isolation architecture that lets us honor enterprise IP contracts under audit.

Define and execute a comprehensive strategic Go-To-Market (GTM) plan for the global Automotive & Manufacturing sector, including industry solution prioritization, repeatable pipeline generation, market segmentation, and competitive positioning.

The Opportunity

Firefly Foundry
is a new business venture at Adobe — an enterprise managed-service offering for custom multimedia generative AI. The offering includes deep-tuned custom image, video, and 3D models built on each customer’s IP, paired with creative workflows for content production and VFX, deployed across new and existing Adobe surfaces, and surrounded by a media intelligence layer. The business has gained significant traction in Media & Entertainment (M&E), marketing, and consumer retail, and is rapidly expanding into adjacent verticals.

We are hiring a Director, ML Engineering
to own the engineering function behind Firefly Foundry’s model services at enterprise scale. This is a multi-faceted executive role with end-to-end accountability for how Firefly Foundry’s models are productionized, served, and operated for our enterprise customers — and for the engineering organization that delivers that capability.

What This Role Owns

You will define and implement the technical strategy that turns Firefly Foundry from a managed service for early-design partners into a platform capable of serving hundreds of enterprise customers concurrently — each with their own IP, tenancy boundaries, and SLAs — powering everything from franchise extensions and new IP development to modern GenAI workflows at production scale. Specifically, you will:

Set the engineering operating model for productionizing custom generative models across image, video, and 3D — including the architectural patterns that simplify pipeline construction and let us absorb a heterogeneous mix of internal and external models without linear engineering cost.
Own the unit economics of Firefly Foundry inference. Cost-to-serve, GPU utilization, and gross margin on the managed service are your numbers.
Define the tenancy and data-isolation architecture that lets us honor enterprise IP contracts under audit.
Drive the self-serve roadmap that broadens Firefly Foundry’s reach and value beyond hands-on engagements.
Represent Adobe engineering in C-suite and senior technical conversations with studios, brands, and global enterprises — including VPs of Production, CTOs, and Chief Digital Officers.

Who You Will Partner With

Applied Science — to ensure inference quality matches the training environment, and to make prioritization calls on emerging techniques for multimedia
Firefly Foundry Studio — to translate ambitious creative visions into reliable, high-performance ML systems that transform how content is conceived, produced, and delivered, and into concrete roadmaps with clear milestones and success metrics.
Post-sales field organization — engagement managers and creative technologists in customer engagements, where you serve as the engineering leadership representative and educate the field on APIs and services.
AI Platform, and adjacent Adobe orgs — to negotiate shared infrastructure, accelerator capacity, and serving primitives at platform scale.
Strategic partners — including GPU vendors and hyperscalers, where capacity planning, roadmap alignment, and partnership economics are part of your remit.

What You Will Do

Build and lead the engineering organization

Lead a multi-team engineering organization of ML engineers and engineering managers; recruit, hire, develop, and retain senior technical and leadership talent, and build a culture of engineering rigor and delivery discipline.
Hiring at scale is a material part of this role — Firefly Foundry is growing rapidly, and sustaining scaling momentum depends on it. You will integrate top technical and leadership talent into the organization at the pace the business demands.
Establish the engineering bar, the bench, and the talent strategy that let Firefly Foundry sustain 10x growth in capability breadth and traffic without linear headcount growth.
Define the operating rhythm — goal-setting, exec reviews, and engineering reviews — that keeps a fast-scaling org coordinated.

Define and own the technical strategy

Own the multi-year architecture for training and inference at scale: pipeline construction, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, model lifecycle management, and accelerator utilization (CUDA, NCCL, and the wider GPU stack).
Set the strategy for fast model deployment, parallel pipeline operation at scale, tenancy/data isolation, and self-serve capability buildout.
Make the build-vs-buy and prioritization calls on emerging GenAI techniques in partnership with Applied Science, based on material improvements in capability, cost, or speed.

Own production reliability and economics

Hold the line on production SLAs for orchestrated and deployed model services.
Own analytics and observability across every model pipeline — quality, latency, cost, and utilization.
Drive cost-to-serve down on a multi-year curve while expanding capability.

Drive customer and partner outcomes

Represent engineering in technical customer engagements with enterprise customers — translating creative and business requirements into ML roadmaps, milestones, and success metrics.
Co-design scalable, cost-efficient serving for real-time on-set use cases and high-volume social content generation, in partnership with infrastructure and platform teams.
Steward the GPU vendor and hyperscaler relationships that underwrite Firefly Foundry’s serving capacity.

What You Bring

Leadership scope

10+ years in applied machine learning and ML systems, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations — with prior experience leading managers of managers.
Demonstrated success shipping generative AI products in production at enterprise scale.
Proven ability to operate as a peer to VP-level partners across product, science, infrastructure, and field organizations, and to represent engineering credibly in front of senior customer and partner executives.
Track record of building engineering benches, defining career frameworks for emerging roles, and developing leaders who themselves become directors.

Technical judgment

Deep understanding of the modern generative model landscape (diffusion, transformers, VAEs, latent video models, control/adapters, or similar) — enough to make architecture, investment, and prioritization calls with confidence, in close partnership with Applied Science.
Strong intuition for the economics and engineering reality of large-scale inference: accelerator stacks, model optimization and quantization, and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and cost.
Experience designing and operating ML systems end-to-end — data, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — at production scale.
Familiarity with high-resolution media pipelines (4K+ video, high bit-depth) or adjacent bandwidth- and latency-sensitive domains is a meaningful plus.

Communication and judgment

Executive presence and communication skills — able to brief executives, customers, and partners credibly, and to work directly with creative, production, and business collaborators to turn ambiguous problems into clear technical plans.
Sound judgment under ambiguity — comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and revising as new information arrives.

Education

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience building and leading advanced ML systems.

AI agents are becoming the primary way developers build and operate software — agent activity spans nearly a million AWS accounts, and agents now make tens of billions of AWS API calls every month. new_jobs.description:
Overview

The Online Forensics team sits within the Microsoft AI Experiences organization, where we protect the monetization network that funds the products people use every day. Because attackers adapt quickly, effective defense must anticipate emerging abuse—not just respond to incidents. You will establish authoritative ground truth on fraud, surface evolving tactics, identify vulnerabilities before they are exploited at scale, and produce the signals, datasets, and test scenarios partner defense teams need.

As a Principal Applied Scientist
on the Online Forensics team, you will shape the scientific strategy for protecting Microsoft’s monetization network. You will assess threats in monetization and advertising flows and LLM-native systems, track adversary behavior and infrastructure, design safe adversarial simulations, and develop test harnesses and investigation platforms that expose blind spots early. When material incidents occur, you will lead rigorous reconstruction and convert validated findings into labeled ground truth, candidate signals, and regression scenarios that partner defense teams can use to strengthen defenses.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

Identify emerging fraud tactics, adversary infrastructure, and evasion patterns across monetization flows and LLM-native systems through threat modeling, behavioral, graph-based, temporal, and cross-surface big data analysis.
Assess high-risk assumptions and attack paths by forming explicit threat hypotheses, identifying observable signals, and validating risk through structured modeling, targeted experiments, and quantitative measurement.
Design safe adversarial simulations that expose blind spots, then convert the results into test harnesses, monitored indicators, and reproducible regression scenarios for sister defense teams.
Establish authoritative ground truth by correlating evidence across accounts, traffic, transactions, providers, devices, and infrastructure; reconstruct attack chains and document their provenance, confidence, scale, and economic exposure.
Develop shared investigation infrastructure, agent-assisted services, and reusable libraries for telemetry analysis, entity resolution, attack-sequence reconstruction, and reproducible case analysis and convert into actionable insights.
When material incidents occur, lead end-to-end reconstruction, document actionable findings, and support the sister teams responsible for remediation and enforcement through validation of closure.
Shape the scientific and technical strategy for monetization fraud intelligence, validation, and investigation capabilities across organizational boundaries.
Embody our Culture and Values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 9+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR equivalent experience.

Demonstrated experience proactively identifying and investigating adversarial abuse at web scale through hypothesis-driven analysis of large-scale traffic or transaction telemetry and entity resolution across complex ecosystems.
Demonstrated ability to produce written technical assessments that stand up to scrutiny, stating mechanism, evidence, confidence and economic impact clearly enough for engineering and executive audiences to act on.
Demonstrated experience developing and evaluating machine learning or statistical detection methods on large-scale telemetry, including label validation and measurement of precision, recall, coverage, and drift; and shipping production services or data pipelines using Python and large-data tools such as Spark or SQL.
Direct experience with advertising or monetization fraud ecosystems, including invalid traffic detection, OpenRTB and supply-path mechanics, click and conversion fraud, botnets, device spoofing, residential proxy networks, or synthetic identity abuse.
Red team, offensive security, or adversarial simulation experience, with a track record of designing safe attack simulations and converting findings into reusable regression tests rather than one-off exploits.
Working knowledge of LLM-native attack surfaces and agent-assisted analysis tooling, with experience in relevant methods such as structured threat modeling, graph analysis, anomaly detection, controlled experimentation, attack replay, FMEA, or STPA.
Experience influencing outcomes across organizational boundaries, where the evidence you produce is acted on by teams that own remediation and enforcement rather than by your own team.

new_jobs.description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta

Parameta Solutions is the Data & Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post-trade analytics. Its post-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data & Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton-Taylor Consulting.

Role Overview

The Capital Markets Product team within Parameta Solutions is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead the strategy, development, commercialization and lifecycle management of Indicative Pricing and Market Data products across global capital markets, with a particular focus on driving growth and market leadership across Asia-Pacific.

Based in Singapore, this role is responsible for defining and executing the strategic vision for a broad portfolio of pricing and market data products derived from TP ICAP's global broking franchise. The successful candidate will work closely with senior stakeholders across Broking, Sales, Technology, Analytics, Data Science, Operations and Compliance to identify, develop and commercialize differentiated data and analytics solutions.

The role combines strategic product leadership, commercial management and market expertise, requiring a deep understanding of fixed income and derivatives markets, pricing methodologies, market structure, client workflows and the evolving data requirements of institutional market participants.

The Director will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding data monetization opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, and strengthening Parameta Solutions' position as a leading provider of pricing and market intelligence solutions globally, while ensuring strong representation of Asian market requirements and opportunities within the broader product strategy.

Role Responsibilities

Define and execute the product strategy, vision and multi-year roadmap for Indicative Pricing and Market Data products globally, with particular emphasis on agreed asset classes and driving growth across Asia-Pacific, including product business cases, commercial positioning and P&L performance.
Own the commercial success and lifecycle management of the product portfolio, encompassing product definition, requirements, development, testing, operational readiness, client adoption, revenue growth and ongoing optimization.
Partner with Global Broking leadership, Desk Heads and regional stakeholders to source new datasets, enhance data capture and maximize the commercial value of broker-generated information.
Lead cross-functional product development initiatives, working closely with Engineering, Quantitative Research, Analytics, Data Science, Product Proposition and Implementation teams to deliver innovative data and analytics solutions that address evolving client needs.
Maintain and enhance existing product offerings, ensuring methodologies, pricing models, benchmarks, analytics and data standards remain aligned with evolving market structures, trading conventions, regulatory requirements and client workflows.
Apply deep cross-asset market expertise to assess pricing methodologies, valuation approaches, market conventions and model outputs, supporting the development of robust, transparent and commercially relevant products.
Establish and maintain strong product governance, including methodology oversight, data quality standards, operational processes, documentation and client transparency.
Represent the voice of the client by engaging with buy-side, sell-side and market infrastructure participants to understand market developments, gather feedback and identify opportunities for product innovation and expansion.
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Client Success teams to develop and execute Go-To-Market strategies, sales enablement, client use cases, product collateral, thought leadership and training initiatives that support commercial growth.
Build and manage strategic relationships with internal stakeholders, third-party data providers and industry partners to strengthen the competitiveness and reach of the Capital Markets Data product portfolio.
Provide leadership and mentorship across the Product organization, fostering collaboration, innovation and best practices while operating effectively in a fast-paced global environment and representing Parameta Solutions with clients and stakeholders across key financial markets.
Work with Analytics and Implementation specialists to support the design, development and execution of new Product ideas

Experience / Competences

Essential

Extensive experience in financial market data, indicative pricing, pricing services, valuations, trading or related capital markets products.
Deep understanding of fixed income and derivatives markets, including market structure, liquidity dynamics, valuation approaches and trading workflows.
Proven track record of developing, commercializing and managing revenue-generating market data products.
Strong understanding of institutional client workflows across trading, portfolio management, risk management, valuation, IPV and regulatory functions.
Experience working closely with broking, trading, quantitative, technology and commercial teams.
Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, build business cases and deliver commercial outcomes. Strong commercial acumen, including P&L responsibility, pricing strategy and revenue growth management.
Excellent stakeholder management skills with experience influencing senior business leaders and decision-makers. Strong communication and presentation skills, including direct engagement with clients, executives and industry stakeholders.
Technical proficiency in Excel and SQL.
Willingness and ability to travel across Asia and internationally as required
High level of professional integrity, analytical rigor, attention to detail, and problem-solving capability

Desired

Strong knowledge of Asian fixed income and derivatives markets.
Experience with pricing and valuation methodologies across Rates, Credit, FX, Inflation, Emerging Markets and Structured Products.
Familiarity with Bloomberg, LSEG Workspace, Numerix, Yield Book, ICE Data Services and other market data or valuation platforms.
Programming experience in Python, VBA or similar analytical tools.
Strong client focus: ability to build relationships, communicate effectively, and manage diverse stakeholders
Demonstrated innovation mindset, including identifying improvements and developing new approaches

We design Spotify’s consumer experience - end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to help lead the audiobook experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. You’ll join Format Foundations within Core Experience and partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to shape how listeners discover, evaluate, enjoy, and build lasting relationships with audiobooks on Spotify.

What You'll Do

Lead product strategy for Spotify’s audiobook experience, shaping how the format becomes more engaging, valuable, and enjoyable for listeners, creators, and the business.
Define and evolve the experience across the audiobook journey, from discovery and evaluation through playback, library management, and reading.
Partner closely with the Audiobooks business unit to translate business strategy and listener needs into product innovation that supports growth.
Drive innovation across multimodal experiences, including the intersection of listening and reading.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences at scale.
Use data, experimentation, and user insights to make informed product decisions and continuously improve the experience.
Build alignment across Core Experience, Audiobooks, Personalization, and other partners to create a cohesive Spotify experience.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, setting direction and scope, creating alignment, and partnering with Engineering on delivery.

Who You Are

You have 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with audiobook, ebook, digital reading, or related consumer products.
You have a deep understanding of the audiobook or digital reading landscape, including user behavior, publisher ecosystems, and competitive dynamics.
You have experience building consumer products for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user experiences.
